data.title: W Residences
data.about:
Introducing W Residences Dubai, located in the dynamic Jumeirah Lakes Towers, where sophistication meets luxury living. This exciting development by Signature Developers is exclusively marketed by Devmark. These branded residences offer a unique fusion of contemporary elegance, offering residents a refined lifestyle with close proximity to key landmarks and attractions.

W Residences at Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT) feature a stunning collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom homes, thoughtfully designed to optimize space and natural light. With sizes ranging from 880 sq. ft. to a generous 2,264 sq. ft., each residence is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, boasting modern elegance, high ceilings, and floor-to-ceiling windows for seamless indoor-outdoor living.

characteristics_module.title: Exclusive Luxury Living at W Residences Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Branded Residences: W Residences bring the iconic W lifestyle brand to Dubai, offering a unique blend of luxury, bold design, and sophistication.
  • Prime Location: Located in JLT, just minutes from key destinations like Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Marina, and Dubai Mall.
  • World-Class Amenities: Residents enjoy access to the WET Deck, outdoor fitness areas, kids and teens zones, a co-working space, a FIT Gym, yoga and Pilates studio, and more.
  • Signature Services: The Whatever/Whenever service offers residents 24/7 assistance for a variety of needs, from concierge services to private reservations.
  • Luxurious Interiors: Thoughtfully designed by LW Design, each residence features modern elegance with high ceilings, large windows for abundant natural light, and premium finishes.
  • Flexible Layouts: Choose from 1, 2, and 3-bedroom branded residences, with spacious layouts, offering a perfect blend of style and functionality.
  • Bespoke Community Spaces: Residents have access to a variety of curated communal areas, including a music corner, screening room, sound suite, exhibition kitchen, and private meeting rooms.

location_tile.title: Experience Unmatched Connectivity and Luxury Living in Jumeirah Lakes Towers
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Strategically situated in the prestigious Jumeirah Lakes Towers, W Residences Dubai offers residents a harmonious blend of luxury, connectivity, and lifestyle. This vibrant locality is surrounded by serene waterfront views, lush green parks, and an exceptional array of dining, retail, and entertainment options, ensuring that every convenience is just moments away.

The project's proximity to major roads and transportation hubs enhances its appeal, providing swift access to key attractions across the city. Residents enjoy seamless travel to prominent destinations, ensuring that leisure, work, and play are all within easy reach.

  • 2 Minutes from Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 4 Minutes from the nearest Metro Station
  • 9 Minutes from Dubai Marina
  • 14 Minutes from Mall of the Emirates
  • 20 Minutes from Dubai Mall
  • 30 Minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport

more_info.answer: W Residences Dubai offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, with sizes ranging from 880 sq. ft. to 2,264 sq. ft., catering to a variety of lifestyles.

more_info.answer: Residents enjoy a host of luxurious amenities, including a WET® Deck with Jacuzzi, outdoor fitness areas, kids’ zones, coffee bar, and flexible private meeting rooms, enhancing their living experience.

more_info.answer: The project features a limited number of branded residences, promoting exclusivity and privacy for its residents.
